metadata.description: Craig Hughes' Claude Code plugins: core instructions and agent routes, model selection, Bluesky, language tooling, dev workflows, and 3D-print mesh prep

plugins.name: craig-core
plugins.description: Craig's global instructions (injected at session and sub-agent start), Claude route agents (craig-core:<route>), and the review-changes, plan-review and my-writing-style skills

plugins.name: model-selection
plugins.description: Compare language models on Artificial Analysis benchmarks, price, speed, and task fit; holds the facts behind the agent routes

plugins.name: bluesky
plugins.description: Read Bluesky posts, threads, profiles and search; draft in Craig's voice and post or delete as @craig.rungie.com only after a preview and explicit confirmation

plugins.name: resin-print-prep
plugins.description: Prep 3D meshes for resin printing in Blender (via Blender MCP): repair, orient, scale, error-bounded decimation, verified STL export

plugins.name: javascript
plugins.description: JavaScript/Node.js development tools - npm packages and Bun runtime

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript-specific development tools - type checking, strict mode, and TSDoc

plugins.name: generic-dev
plugins.description: Generic development tools for any coding project - symbol editing, documentation, and code navigation

plugins.name: hugo
plugins.description: Hugo static site development plugin with agents for template development, content management, asset pipeline, and AWS deployment

plugins.name: duckdb
plugins.description: DuckDB MCP server for data analysis

plugins.name: tmux
plugins.description: Tmux MCP server integration for terminal multiplexer support

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive git commands that discard uncommitted work (in-process tool.call mod)

plugins.name: mods-probe
plugins.description: Flag tracker: on session.start shows a notice and logs a line to ~/.claude/mods-flag.log when hooks modules are ON
